# Musxi source additions

The base KuGouMusicApi 1.6.0 source remains pinned to
`a5a98013cce79fe0ae2ad65fc84b68176ebcfc1e` and is restored by setup-cloud.ps1.
Three unchanged MIT modules supplement that base from upstream commit
`ec5e0fb9ea020d1f1c8dc4edc160011258070a24`:

- module/user_verify.js
- module/song_auth.js
- module/song_url_auth.js

Source: https://github.com/MakcRe/KuGouMusicApi/tree/ec5e0fb9ea020d1f1c8dc4edc160011258070a24/module
